---
title: "Nonprehensile Manipulation"
description: "Planning through contact: when the planner must invent the contact sequence, not just track one."
---

::: {.research-page}

::: {.research-lead}
When a robot cannot grasp an object, the plan *is* the sequence of contacts.
:::

Pushing, toppling, pivoting, and re-acquiring an object are all cases in which
the robot never closes a rigid grasp. The object moves because contacts are
made and broken in the right order, and the hard part of the problem is
deciding that order. A trajectory optimizer cannot recover from a contact
sequence that was wrong to begin with.

Our work asks a specific question: **what should the discrete object be, if the
planner is expected to invent contacts that do not exist yet?**

## The method at a glance {#overview}

The whole method is one loop: an offline planner turns the task into a chain
of certified edges, and online feedback runs them on the plant. Click a
block to zoom in.

:::

::: {.column-page-right}

  /* TODO: if a background page is renamed, update the L table above. */

  /* ---- index the tree ---- */
  var NODES = {};
  function index(n, parent, depth) {
    NODES[n.id] = n; n.parent = parent; n.depth = depth;
    (n.kids || []).forEach(function (k) { index(k, n, depth + 1); });
  }
  index(TREE, null, 0);
  function zoomable(n) { return !!(n.kids && n.kids.length); }
  /* Global rect of a node's box, and the scale of its children's frame. */
  function frameOf(n) { // transform of n's child frame: [tx, ty, s]
    if (n === TREE) return [0, 0, 1];
    var p = frameOf(n.parent), b = n.box;
    return [p[0] + b[0] * p[2], p[1] + b[1] * p[2], p[2] * b[2] / 1000];
  }
  function viewOf(n) {
    if (n === TREE) return [0, 0, 1000, 600];
    var p = frameOf(n.parent), b = n.box;
    var x = p[0] + b[0] * p[2], y = p[1] + b[1] * p[2], w = b[2] * p[2], h = b[3] * p[2];
    var pad = 0.01;
    return [x - pad * w, y - pad * h, w * (1 + 2 * pad), h * (1 + 2 * pad)];
  }

  /* ---- render ---- */
  function esc(s) { return String(s).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;"); }
  var compact = false;
  function face(n) {
    var b = n.box, x = b[0], y = b[1], w = b[2], h = b[3], cx = x + w / 2, out = "";
    var big = compact ? 30 : 24, small = 17, lh = big * 1.18, sh = 21;
    var lab = n.label || [], sub = compact ? [] : (n.sub || []);
    if (n.face === "top") {
      out += '<text class="lbl" x="' + cx + '" y="' + (y + 28) + '" font-size="' + big + '" text-anchor="middle" data-w="' + (w - 18) + '">' + esc(lab[0]) + '</text>';
      out += n.art || "";
      if (!compact) sub.forEach(function (s) { out += '<text class="sub" x="' + cx + '" y="' + (y + h - 10) + '" font-size="' + small + '" text-anchor="middle" data-w="' + (w - 18) + '">' + esc(s) + '</text>'; });
    } else {
      var total = lab.length * lh + sub.length * sh + (sub.length ? 4 : 0);
      var ty = y + h / 2 - total / 2 + big * 0.85;
      lab.forEach(function (s, i) { out += '<text class="lbl" x="' + cx + '" y="' + (ty + i * lh) + '" font-size="' + big + '" text-anchor="middle" data-w="' + (w - 20) + '">' + esc(s) + '</text>'; });
      var sy = ty + (lab.length - 1) * lh + 4 + sh;
      sub.forEach(function (s, i) { out += '<text class="sub" x="' + cx + '" y="' + (sy + i * sh) + '" font-size="' + small + '" text-anchor="middle" data-w="' + (w - 20) + '">' + esc(s) + '</text>'; });
    }
    if (n.planned) {
      out += '<g class="tag"><rect x="' + (x + w - 82) + '" y="' + (y - 11) + '" width="74" height="22" rx="11"/>' +
             '<text x="' + (x + w - 45) + '" y="' + (y + 5) + '" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle">planned</text></g>';
    }
    if (zoomable(n)) {
      var bx = x + w - 17, by = y + 17;
      out += '<g class="zbadge" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="' + bx + '" cy="' + by + '" r="10"/>' +
             '<path d="M' + (bx - 5) + ',' + by + ' H' + (bx + 5) + ' M' + bx + ',' + (by - 5) + ' V' + (by + 5) + '"/></g>';
    }
    return out;
  }
  function arrowSvg(a) {
    var cls = a.planned ? " planned" : "";
    var o = '<path class="arr' + cls + '" d="' + a.d + '" marker-end="url(#sm-ah' + (a.planned ? "p" : "") + ')"/>';
    if (a.tick) {
      var tx = a.tick[0], ty = a.tick[1];
      o += a.tick[2] ? '<line class="tick" x1="' + (tx - 12) + '" y1="' + ty + '" x2="' + (tx + 12) + '" y2="' + ty + '"/>'
                     : '<line class="tick" x1="' + tx + '" y1="' + (ty - 12) + '" x2="' + tx + '" y2="' + (ty + 12) + '"/>';
    }
    if (a.t) {
      var anc = a.a || "middle";
      o += '<text class="alb' + cls + '" x="' + a.x + '" y="' + a.y + '" font-size="16" text-anchor="' + anc + '">' + esc(a.t) + '</text>';
      if (a.t2) o += '<text class="alb' + cls + '" x="' + a.x + '" y="' + (a.y + 18) + '" font-size="16" text-anchor="' + anc + '">' + esc(a.t2) + '</text>';
    }
    return o;
  }
  function levelSvg(n) { // contents of n's child frame (local 1000 x 600)
    var o = '<g class="sm-deco" data-of="' + n.id + '">' + (n.decor || "");
    (n.arrows || []).forEach(function (a) { o += arrowSvg(a); });
    o += '</g>';
    (n.kids || []).forEach(function (k) {
      var b = k.box;
      var aria = k.d.title + (k.planned || k.d.planned ? " (planned)" : "") + (zoomable(k) ? ": zoom in" : ": show details");
      o += '<g class="sm-node' + (zoomable(k) ? " zoomable" : "") + (k.planned ? " planned" : "") + '" data-id="' + k.id +
           '" role="button" tabindex="-1" aria-label="' + esc(aria) + '">' +
           '<rect class="sm-box" x="' + b[0] + '" y="' + b[1] + '" width="' + b[2] + '" height="' + b[3] + '" rx="12"/>' +
           '<g class="sm-face">' + face(k) + '</g></g>';
      if (zoomable(k)) {
        o += '<g class="sm-inner" data-of="' + k.id + '" transform="translate(' + b[0] + ',' + b[1] + ') scale(' + (b[2] / 1000) + ')">' + levelSvg(k) + '</g>';
      }
    });
    return o;
  }
  function render() {
    svg.innerHTML =
      '<defs><marker id="sm-ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">' +
      '<path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"/></marker>' +
      '<marker id="sm-ahp" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse">' +
      '<path class="ah planned" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"/></marker></defs>' +
      '<g class="sm-root">' + levelSvg(TREE) + '</g>';
    fitText();
  }
  function fitText() {
    svg.querySelectorAll("text[data-w]").forEach(function (t) {
      var max = +t.getAttribute("data-w"), fs = +t.getAttribute("font-size");
      var len = 0;
      try { len = t.getComputedTextLength(); } catch (e) { return; }
      if (len > max && len > 0) t.setAttribute("font-size", (fs * max / len).toFixed(2));
    });
  }

  /* ---- state ---- */
  var cur = TREE, view = [0, 0, 1000, 600], anim = null, selected = null;
  function setView(v) { view = v; svg.setAttribute("viewBox", v.map(function (z) { return z.toFixed(3); }).join(" ")); }
  function animateTo(target, dur, done) {
    if (anim) cancelAnimationFrame(anim);
    var reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
    if (!dur || reduce) { setView(target); if (done) done(); return; }
    var from = view.slice(), t0 = null;
    var c0 = [from[0] + from[2] / 2, from[1] + from[3] / 2], c1 = [target[0] + target[2] / 2, target[1] + target[3] / 2];
    function ease(t) { return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2; }
    function step(ts) {
      if (t0 === null) t0 = ts;
      var u = Math.min(1, (ts - t0) / dur), e = ease(u);
      var w = Math.exp(Math.log(from[2]) * (1 - e) + Math.log(target[2]) * e);
      var h = Math.exp(Math.log(from[3]) * (1 - e) + Math.log(target[3]) * e);
      var cx = c0[0] + (c1[0] - c0[0]) * e, cy = c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * e;
      setView([cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, w, h]);
      if (u < 1) anim = requestAnimationFrame(step); else { anim = null; if (done) done(); }
    }
    anim = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }
  function pathTo(n) { var p = []; while (n) { p.unshift(n); n = n.parent; } return p; }
  function nodeEl(id) { return svg.querySelector('.sm-node[data-id="' + id + '"]'); }
  function innerEl(id) { return svg.querySelector('.sm-inner[data-of="' + id + '"]'); }
  function applyClasses(openSet, showInner) {
    svg.querySelectorAll(".sm-node").forEach(function (el) {
      var id = el.getAttribute("data-id");
      el.classList.toggle("open", openSet.indexOf(id) >= 0);
      el.classList.toggle("sel", selected === id);
      var n = NODES[id];
      el.setAttribute("tabindex", n.parent === cur ? "0" : "-1");
      el.setAttribute("aria-hidden", n.parent === cur ? "false" : "true");
    });
    svg.querySelectorAll(".sm-deco").forEach(function (el) {
      el.classList.toggle("dim", el.getAttribute("data-of") !== cur.id);
    });
    svg.querySelectorAll(".sm-inner").forEach(function (el) {
      var id = el.getAttribute("data-of");
      el.classList.toggle("on", showInner.indexOf(id) >= 0);
    });
  }
  function ids(list) { return list.map(function (n) { return n.id; }); }
  function zoomTo(n, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    var prev = cur;
    cur = n; selected = null;
    var path = pathTo(n).slice(1), open = ids(path);
    var prevOpen = ids(pathTo(prev).slice(1));
    var dur = opts.instant ? 0 : 650;
    if (opts.instant) { svg.classList.add("notrans"); setTimeout(function () { svg.classList.remove("notrans"); }, 50); }
    // collapse first (children of nodes being closed fade out), then move, then open
    var keep = open.filter(function (id) { return prevOpen.indexOf(id) >= 0; });
    applyClasses(open, keep);
    animateTo(viewOf(n), dur, function () { applyClasses(open, open); if (opts.focusId) { var el = nodeEl(opts.focusId); if (el) el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } });
    showDetails(n);
    updateBar();
    if (!opts.noHash) writeHash();
  }
  function showDetails(n) {
    var d = n.d, planned = n.planned || d.planned;
    var h = '<h3>' + esc(d.title) + '</h3>';
    if (planned) h += '<span class="chip planned">Planned</span>';
    else if (n !== TREE) h += '<span class="chip">' + esc(d.chip || "Built") + '</span>';
    (d.text || []).forEach(function (p) { h += '<p>' + esc(p) + '</p>'; });
    if (zoomable(n) && n !== cur) h += '<p class="zoomhint">Press Enter or click the block to zoom in.</p>';
    if (d.links && d.links.length) {
      h += '<ul class="more">';
      d.links.forEach(function (k) { var l = L[k]; if (l) h += '<li><a href="' + l[0] + '">' + esc(l[1]) + '</a></li>'; });
      h += '</ul>';
    }
    panel.innerHTML = h;
  }
  function updateBar() {
    var p = pathTo(cur), h = "";
    p.forEach(function (n, i) {
      if (i) h += '<span class="sep" aria-hidden="true">›</span>';
      h += (n === cur) ? '<span class="here" aria-current="location">' + esc(n.name || n.d.title.split(":")[0].split(" (")[0]) + '</span>'
                       : '<button type="button" data-id="' + n.id + '">' + esc(n.name || n.d.title.split(":")[0].split(" (")[0]) + '</button>';
    });
    crumbs.innerHTML = h;
    backBtn.disabled = (cur === TREE);
  }
  function writeHash() {
    var url = location.pathname + location.search + (cur === TREE ? "" : "#zoom=" + cur.id);
    try { history.replaceState(null, "", url); } catch (e) {}
  }
  function zoomOut() { if (cur.parent) zoomTo(cur.parent, { focusId: cur.id }); }
  function activate(id, viaKey) {
    var n = NODES[id]; if (!n || n === cur) return;
    if (zoomable(n)) {
      var firstKid = viaKey && n.kids[0] ? n.kids[0].id : null;
      zoomTo(n, { focusId: firstKid });
    } else {
      selected = id; showDetails(n);
      svg.querySelectorAll(".sm-node").forEach(function (el) { el.classList.toggle("sel", el.getAttribute("data-id") === id); });
    }
  }

  /* ---- events ---- */
  svg.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest(".sm-node"); if (!el) return;
    var n = NODES[el.getAttribute("data-id")];
    if (n.parent !== cur) return; // only the current level is live
    activate(n.id, false);
  });
  svg.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".sm-node");
    if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && el) { e.preventDefault(); activate(el.getAttribute("data-id"), true); }
  });
  svg.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) {
    var el = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".sm-node");
    if (el) { var n = NODES[el.getAttribute("data-id")]; if (n && n.parent === cur) showDetails(n); }
  });
  root.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && cur !== TREE) { e.preventDefault(); zoomOut(); }
  });
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && cur !== TREE && (document.activeElement === document.body || !document.activeElement)) zoomOut();
  });
  backBtn.addEventListener("click", zoomOut);
  crumbs.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("button"); if (!b) return;
    var t = NODES[b.getAttribute("data-id")], f = pathTo(cur).filter(function (n) { return n.parent === t; })[0];
    zoomTo(t, { focusId: f ? f.id : null });
  });

  /* ---- URL: #zoom=<id>[&theme=dark|light]; ?theme= also works ---- */
  function readHash(instant) {
    var h = (location.hash || "").replace(/^#/, ""), q = location.search.replace(/^\?/, "");
    var params = {};
    (q + "&" + h).split("&").forEach(function (kv) { var m = kv.match(/^(zoom|theme|sel)[=-](.+)$/); if (m) params[m[1]] = decodeURIComponent(m[2]); });
    if (params.theme && typeof window.quartoToggleColorScheme === "function") {
      var dark = document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark");
      if ((params.theme === "dark") !== dark) window.quartoToggleColorScheme();
    }
    var n = params.zoom && NODES[params.zoom];
    if (n && !zoomable(n)) { selected = n.id; n = n.parent; }
    if (n) {
      var s = selected;
      zoomTo(n, { instant: instant, noHash: true });
      if (s) { selected = s; showDetails(NODES[s]); applyClasses(ids(pathTo(n).slice(1)), ids(pathTo(n).slice(1))); }
      return true;
    }
    if (params.sel && NODES[params.sel]) { activate(params.sel, false); }
    return false;
  }
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
    if (/zoom[=-]/.test(location.hash)) readHash(false);
  });

  function setCompact() {
    var c = root.clientWidth < 620;
    if (c !== compact) { compact = c; render(); applyClasses(ids(pathTo(cur).slice(1)), ids(pathTo(cur).slice(1))); setView(viewOf(cur)); }
  }
  compact = root.clientWidth < 620;
  render();
  setView(viewOf(TREE));
  applyClasses([], []);
  showDetails(TREE);
  updateBar();
  readHash(true);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(function () { render(); applyClasses(ids(pathTo(cur).slice(1)), ids(pathTo(cur).slice(1))); });
  window.addEventListener("resize", setCompact);
})();
</script>

::: {.research-page}

## Planning through contact

::: {.research-paper}

**Planar build**

[Planar Build →](planar-build/index.qmd) — the current construction on the
planar step scene, by topic: contact states, edits, the hold gate and its
certificates, the local solver and the search, with figures, an interactive
viewer, and the open issues.

**Results**

[Results →](results/index.qmd): from the scene alone, the planner finds the
lift in which the box is held at every instant in 17 of 34 held-out searches,
and in 26 of 34 after two rounds of a learned value and ranker; with videos.

:::

The construction has five pieces:

- **Formations.** Every body carries a finite, named inventory of features
  (edges and convex vertices). A candidate contact (a *template*) is a pair of
  features on two bodies with a signed gap, defined whether or not the pair
  touches. A *formation* is the set of templates in principal contact, in the
  sense of Xiao and Ji, recognized from a pose with small tolerances; it is
  the discrete state, carried alongside the continuous pose.
- **Edits.** Neighbouring formations differ by making, breaking or
  transferring one contact; several change at once only when no single change
  is possible (the pivot). A transport moves the object without changing
  contacts.
- **The hold gate.** Before an edit is tried, a linear program checks that
  the contacts that persist through it can hold the object against gravity,
  within the manipulator's actuator limits, at a pose where the change can
  happen. In its idealized form it never discards a realizable edit, and an
  interval version certifies the hold over whole regions of poses.
- **Realization.** A local solver, a quasi-static realizer that plans on the
  edit's known contacts and tracks the plan in simulation, either realizes the
  edit or reports why it failed.
- **Search.** A search over edits, ordered by a ranker and a value estimate,
  counts the expensive solver calls, with the number of calls bounded by the
  ranker's probabilities.

The hold gate is what forbids a manipulator from letting go mid-topple, and
admits the same release once the object rests on other contacts.

## Why unmade contacts matter

Complementarity-based planners enumerate velocity modes over the contacts that
collision detection has already found, and graphs of convex sets place modes on
vertices that must be enumerated in advance. Both are effective for reasoning
about contacts a robot already has. Neither can express *go and establish
contact with that edge*, because the contact is not in the state until it
exists.

Here every contact the geometry allows is a named template with a gap defined
before it touches, so *make that contact* is an edge of the graph from the
start. That is the one structural difference, and everything else in the
construction follows from it.

## Status

On a proof-of-concept task, lifting a box onto a step with a disk too weak
to carry it, the planner finds the lift in which the box is held at every
instant, the *indirect lift*, from the scene and the goal alone in 197 of 200
held-out searches and in all 34 of the original test set
([Results](results/index.qmd)). Beside it, one route of the lift is built as a
chain of **certified funnels**, each certified for every disk friction in a
declared band and composed on certified sets: from the box at rest through a
landing impact certified with zonotopes and a transport into the goal,
executed end to end in simulation 1536 times without a failure
([Certified funnels](planar-build/funnels.qmd)). The
[planar build](planar-build/index.qmd) pages give the details, the
[Roadmap](roadmap.qmd) where it goes next, and
[Issues](planar-build/issues.qmd) the open work.
